item.title: Gary Kirsten appointed head coach of Sri Lankan men’s team
item.description: FORMER South African opener, Gary Kirsten, has been appointed the new head coach of the Sri Lankan men’s cricket team. item.title: ICC postpones March 25-27 Doha meeting; may reschedule it in April
item.description: THE meeting of the International Cricket Council (ICC), scheduled for March 25-27 in Doha, Qatar, has been postponed in view of the ongoing war in the region.
